profile.name: 集群任务工作器
profile.description: 用于实验数据处理集群的非物理软件组件。它会持续轮询任务队列、获取待处理任务、执行配方型计算流程，并将结果返回到上游队列或服务。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for experimental data-processing clusters. It continuously polls task queues, fetches pending jobs, executes recipe-based computation workflows, and returns results to an upstream queue or service.
